objective: maximize cumulative user profit while enforcing verified-publication hard minimums and minimizing user intervention

hardPublicationPolicy.rule: Expected-profit optimization may choose WHICH qualified products to publish, but may not reduce the verified-publication floor or erase carried debt.

evidenceState.rule: Do not invent product-level demand, sales, PV, conversion or acquisition numbers. Until observed metrics arrive, rank by publication debt, publishability, coherent buyer journey, external market evidence and incremental build cost.
evidenceState.microsoftMeasurement: Partner Center Acquisition reports can measure page views, install attempts, acquisitions, installs, first launches and source/campaign conversion; collect these before app derivative expansion.
evidenceState.noteMarketSignal: Paid content demand exists, but product-level sales/PV for this account are still unavailable; use pricing/category signals only as provisional evidence.

pcAvailabilityPolicy.assumption: User normally closes Windows PC after 01:00 JST.
pcAvailabilityPolicy.after0100: Do not require Windows publisher execution. Continue cloud research, build preparation, queue/state/ledger repair and fallback preparation.
pcAvailabilityPolicy.frontLoadRule: Paid debt and current-day publication minimums must be pushed toward verified public state before 01:00; do not depend on post-01:00 local execution.

currentRecoveryFinding.note: Source-of-truth quota still requires 6 verified note publications before the day is satisfied (1 carried debt + 5 current-day); repository metrics contain no newer strict-publication evidence.
currentRecoveryFinding.BOOTH: Source-of-truth quota still requires 9 verified BOOTH publications before the day is satisfied (4 carried debt + 5 current-day); repository metrics contain no newer strict-publication evidence.
currentRecoveryFinding.decision: Do not spend another full run on stale note_20260820_05 or BOOTH 009. At each remaining PC window give the stale item only a brief strict attempt, then batch distinct prepared fallbacks. Paid publication recovery outranks another free Web tool until the hard floor is satisfied.

runPlan.goal: Batch paid recovery. Brief legacy retry only; then publish and strict-verify multiple fallbacks if ready.
Continue hard-floor recovery using already prepared or low-build-risk distinct candidates.
Mandatory catch-up; batch as many strict verified publications as qualified candidates permit.
Final PC-dependent recovery before 01:00. Verify formally; residual exact shortfall becomes debt, never zero-cleared.

note.nextAction: 19:10 batch publish prepared fallbacks; legacy gets brief retry only

BOOTH.nextAction: 19:10 batch publish prepared low-incremental-cost fallbacks; legacy gets brief retry only

MicrosoftStore.status: initial publication route proven; keep CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover as first build priority, but paid quota recovery has precedence during remaining PC windows; collect Partner Center funnel metrics before derivative expansion

GitHubPages.priority: defer new free-tool creation while paid hard floor is unsatisfied unless paid pipelines become globally blocked

productionRunPolicy.normalCompletion: At least one newly verified public paid artifact per PC-available production run while debt or quota remains; batch multiple when debt exists.
productionRunPolicy.blockedCandidate: After a brief strict-publication attempt, defer and switch to another qualified candidate rather than ending the run.
nonCompletionEvidence: HTTP/title-only evidence when commerce checks are required

profitRules: Debt and today's verified-publication floor are first priority.
Within that floor, prefer stronger purchase intent, coherent cross-sell fit, lower incremental build cost and higher expected net profit.

Bundles of already verified complementary assets are preferred recovery candidates because they can raise AOV with low incremental production cost, but only if deliverables and buyer-visible purchase path are valid.

Do not create app derivatives until observed Microsoft Store funnel metrics support the theme; first collect page views, install attempts, acquisitions, installs, first launches and source/campaign conversion.
Do not publish plaintext paid assets to GitHub.
Do not infer public URLs or performance metrics.
Do not reactivate KDP or LINE without explicit user instruction.
